name: Good Leaders
overview: Scripture teaches that good leaders are chosen from among those who fear God, are truthful, and reject greed, as seen in Exodus 18:21 where such men are appointed to govern various groups of people. Effective leadership establishes and stabilizes the land through righteous judgment, contrasting with the destructive influence of corruption highlighted in Proverbs 29:4. Furthermore, Hebrews 13:17 emphasizes the responsibility of leaders to watch over the souls of those under their care with accountability, calling for obedience and submission from the community to promote joy rather than grief in their oversight.
